Xiaomi/MIUI: Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Frame out → i-ON ang Autostart. Pagkatapos, Battery saver → No restrictions.
Huawei/Honor: Settings → Apps → Frame out → Battery → App launch → Manage manually → i-enable ang Auto-launch, Secondary launch, at Run in background.
OPPO/Realme/OnePlus: Settings → Apps → Frame out → Battery usage → Allow background activity. I-enable ang Autostart kung may nakikita.
Vivo/iQOO: Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → Frame out → Allow. I-enable rin ang Autostart.
Samsung: Settings → Apps → Frame out → Battery → Allow background activity. Alisin sa Sleeping apps kung nakalista.
